title: Goodwill Schedule: First-Incident Courtesy on Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
Customer care's schedule of the first-incident courtesy for Cleaning and Damage Fees, by fee level.

| Fee level | Disputed fee may be reversed once as a first-incident courtesy | Courtesy lookback | Driver keeps the payout on a courtesy reversal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | Yes | 365 calendar days before the trip | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | No | 365 calendar days before the trip | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | No | 365 calendar days before the trip | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | No | 365 calendar days before the trip | Yes |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | No | 365 calendar days before the trip | Yes |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | No | 365 calendar days before the trip | Yes |

## Terms

- **Eligibility.** Whether a disputed fee at the level may be reversed once as a first-incident courtesy. Only Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) is eligible.
- **Lookback.** A first-incident courtesy needs no other charged assessment against the rider within 365 calendar days before the trip.
- **Payout.** When a fee is reversed as a courtesy, the driver keeps the payout.

A disputed fee at Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant), for example, is not eligible for the courtesy whatever the rider's history, because that level's eligibility is "No".
